In a narrowing, risk-off regime with macro backdrop dominated by geopolitics and unscheduled surprise share at 0.92, the income/defensive character of HK dividend blue chips aligns with validated trend discipline. Momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha — but staying-power via the gate is the one validated leg, and this theme passes it cleanly with cohesion.
